title: How is revenue trending by month?
sql:
SELECT substr(o.order_date, 1, 7) AS month, ROUND(SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price), 2) AS revenue
FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id = o.id
WHERE o.status = 'completed'
GROUP BY month ORDER BY month
note: Revenue is the sum of quantity × unit price for completed orders. All amounts are CAD, before tax. January–September 2026.

title: Which product categories bring in the most revenue?
sql:
SELECT p.category, ROUND(SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price), 2) AS revenue
FROM products p JOIN order_items i ON i.product_id = p.id
JOIN orders o ON o.id = i.order_id
WHERE o.status = 'completed'
GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY revenue DESC
note: Completed orders only. Categories are ranked by gross revenue in CAD before tax.

title: Who are our top 10 customers by revenue?
sql:
SELECT c.name AS customer, c.province, ROUND(SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price), 2) AS revenue
FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id = o.id
WHERE o.status = 'completed'
GROUP BY c.id, c.name, c.province ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 10
note: Top 10 customers by completed-order revenue across the full sample period. Names are fictional.

title: Compare revenue across provinces
sql:
SELECT c.province, ROUND(SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price), 2) AS revenue
FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id = o.id
WHERE o.status = 'completed'
GROUP BY c.province ORDER BY revenue DESC
note: Province is the customer’s province. Revenue includes completed orders only, in CAD.

title: What are our 10 best-selling products?
sql:
SELECT p.name AS product, SUM(i.quantity) AS units_sold, ROUND(SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price), 2) AS revenue
FROM products p JOIN order_items i ON i.product_id = p.id
JOIN orders o ON o.id = i.order_id
WHERE o.status = 'completed'
GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY units_sold DESC LIMIT 10
note: Products ranked by units sold, excluding pending and cancelled orders.

title: How many orders have each status?
sql:
SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS orders FROM orders
GROUP BY status ORDER BY orders DESC
note: Counts include all 720 sample orders. This query does not measure revenue.

title: Compare revenue by customer segment
sql:
SELECT c.segment, ROUND(SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price), 2) AS revenue
FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id = o.id
WHERE o.status = 'completed'
GROUP BY c.segment ORDER BY revenue DESC
note: Revenue by Consumer, Business, and Enterprise segments, for completed orders.

title: What is our average order value?
sql:
SELECT ROUND(SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.id), 2) AS average_order_value, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS completed_orders
FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id = o.id
WHERE o.status = 'completed'
note: Total completed-order revenue divided by the number of completed orders. CAD before tax.
